data_use_note: TCIA data are subject to the TCIA Data Usage Policy and each collection's own licence. The per-series licence recorded in these results must be reproduced in any publication, together with the collection name and the access date.

tag_absence.reconstructability_note: 'fallback_feasibility_rate' is marginal (over all screened series, including those that already carry a recorded CTDIvol). 'conditional_reconstructability_rate' is over the series that lack one, which is the population the reconstruction exists to serve. Report both: the marginal rate describes the archive, the conditional rate describes the method.

provenance.layer: 2 - recorded-dose availability in a public archive, and fallback error
provenance.archive: The Cancer Imaging Archive (TCIA), public NBIA REST API
provenance.summary_rebuilt_note: The per-series and per-case rows are from the original archive run recorded in access_started_utc/access_finished_utc; only the aggregation was recomputed.
provenance.fallback_recomputed_note: The sample, the screens and the exclusion counts are those of the archive run recorded in access_started_utc/access_finished_utc. Only the reconstructed CTDIvol of each case was recomputed, from the same cached images, after the tube-voltage correction and the bowtie inference were added to the estimator.
provenance.rescreened_note: The sample is the archive run recorded in access_started_utc/access_finished_utc; the screened attributes are unchanged. Scanner-model resolution and reconstructability were recomputed against the open coefficient database, which covers a different set of scanners than the table used for the original run.
provenance.fallback_source: results/open_fallback.json -- every screened series the open coefficient database covers that also carries a recorded CTDIvol, not a capped sample
